issue.title: Hijack every bulk-marked agent with a per-agent decision summary

task_type_fields.proposal:
Bulk-marked rows are refused by the v2 hijack decision with a bulk refusal code; `,k` acts on exactly one resolved occupant.

Proposal: let `,k` (and `sase agent hijack` with multiple names) hijack every marked agent, resolving each to its occupant, deduplicating by target key, and reporting a per-agent summary (immediate / latched / redirect / refused with code), with the same exactly-once and at-most-one-successor guarantees as single hijacks.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1t2 (plan:202611/agent_hijack_dependability.md) deferred bulk hijack in its land phase; the epic's scope was single-target correctness, and bulk needs its own UX for mixed per-agent decisions. Proposed by the plan's land phase sase-1t2.14 (not recorded there); filed by the sase-1t2 land agent.

issue.creation_reason: Deferred by epic sase-1t2's land phase and never recorded; the sase-1t2 land agent files it so bulk hijack stays a tracked idea.
